headline: Aspen Group sells European business unit for R3.6 billion
summary: Aspen Group has divested its European business unit in a deal valued at R3.6 billion, citing a strategy to unlock value from assets that can be better managed by other parties.
why: Divestitures are often used by multinational corporations to streamline operations, reduce debt, or focus capital on higher-growth core markets.

impacts.name: Aspen Pharmacare
impacts.why: The sale of a business unit provides immediate cash inflow and potentially improves the company's focus.
